import Effect4

/-!
An `opaque` with no body. Lean synthesises `default_or_ofNonempty%` for the
missing value, so the constant denotes an arbitrary inhabitant nobody chose.

No token gives this away — the keyword is the one a bodied `opaque` uses too,
and the bodied form is admitted — so this is the declaration pass reading the
synthesised value's head constant. It therefore has to be a compiled module
rather than text appended to one; `benign.lean.txt` carries the bodied form the
gate accepts.
-/

namespace Test.PlantedOpaque

opaque plantedBodylessOpaque : Nat

end Test.PlantedOpaque
